notes:
## Changes
- Nothing clickable sits in a window's title band any more. Tools are in a row under the header in Clean up, Duplicate scenes, Favourites sync, Find by face (the three steps) and Media Walls (search, sort, New wall). "Check another" in Torrent check and Folder duplicates sits beside the result, and Edit wall's Save and Cancel are in its footer.
- Empty drop-downs and boxes say what they're for: "Any drive", "Any tag", "Any studio", "Any performer" in the filters, "Type or pick a performer..." in Edit scene, Edit folder, Find by face and elsewhere. "None yet" is gone from Edit scene and Edit folder.

## Fixes
- Dragging to reorder categories and attributes in Settings now shows where the item will land.
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
